paragraphs.text: Clown is a creature type class introduced for Unfinity . While initially largely acorn-stamped , the type appeared on eternal legal cards as well before debuting in a premier set with the release of Duskmourn: House of Horror .

Clowns are comic entertainers who wear traditional comical costumes and exaggerated make-up, especially in a circus. In Unfinity all but one of the Clowns are Robots , but not all the Robots are Clowns. This helped to avoid the creepy clown trope .
Technical clowns have been portrayed in black-bordered Magic in factions like the Cult of Rakdos , which are entertainers visually modeled after harlequins. However, they are not typed as clowns.
Clowns are similar to Zombies , in that they can both be a species and a class.
After Unfinity , Clown reappeared in Duskmourn: House of Horror , where a subset of razorkins are represented as murder clowns.
